defs.def: a short piece of writing by a student as part of a course of study （作为课程作业，学生写的）文章，短文

ex.s: It’s a great idea to make a collection of our English essays.
ex.t: 把我们的英语作文整理成册是个好主意。

ex.s: Why did the students perform poorly in writing their first essay?
ex.t: 为什么学生们在写第一篇作文时表现很差？

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三那年，我和同学们一直担心，当大学招生官把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来审视时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: When I handed in the essay to my teacher, he read it, laughed out loud, and said, “Great.
ex.t: 当我把文章交给老师时，他读了之后放声大笑，说：“很好。

ex.s: An essay on the art of writing.
ex.t: 一篇关于写作艺术的文章。

ex.s: When I handed in the essay to my teacher, he read it, laughed out loud, and said, “Great.
ex.t: 当我把文章交给老师时，他读了之后放声大笑，说：“很好。

ex.s: Now I was paying the price — to write a five-page essay on “Why I Should Not Talk in Class”.
ex.t: 现在我付出了代价——要写一篇五页的文章，题目是"我为什么不该在课堂上讲话"。

ex.s: Soon after dinner, I handed the essay to mum.
ex.t: 晚饭后不久，我把文章交给了妈妈。

ex.s: The next day, when Ms Black read the essay to the class, everyone laughed.
ex.t: 第二天，当布莱克女士在班上朗读这篇文章时，大家都笑了。

ex.s: Your four major essays will combine to form the main part of the grade for this course: Essay 1 = 10%; Essay 2 = 15%; Essay 3 = 15%; Essay 4 = 20%.
ex.t: 你的四篇主要作文将构成本课程成绩的主要部分：作文1 = 10%；作文2 = 15%；作文3 = 15%；作文4 = 20%。

ex.s: An essay not submitted in class on the due date will lose a letter grade for each class period it is late.
ex.t: 如果作文未在截止日期当天课堂上提交，每逾期一个课时就会降低一个字母等级。

ex.s: What will happen if you submit an essay one week after the due date?
ex.t: 如果你在截止日期一周后提交作文会发生什么？

ex.s: Writing an essay is a difficult process for most people.
ex.t: 写论文对大多数人来说是困难的过程。

ex.s: The second draft of the essay should be better.
ex.t: 作文的第二稿应该更好。

ex.s: March 9 Submit a final draft of your essay．
ex.t: 3月9日 提交你作文的终稿。

ex.s: （4）What would a participant have to do with an essay of 1，500 words to meet the category requirement？
ex.t: （4）参赛者要让一篇1500词的作文符合类别要求，需要做什么？

ex.s: Include more information in the essay．
ex.t: A．在论文中包含更多信息。

ex.s: Provide a cover for the essay．
ex.t: C．为论文提供一个封面。

ex.s: Learning to learn An essay usually consists of three parts: introduction, main body and conclusion.
ex.t: 学习学习一篇文章通常由三个部分组成：导言、主体和结论。

ex.s: Start with an introduction that contains the aims and an overview of the essay.
ex.t: 以引言开头，其中包含文章的目的和概述。

ex.s: The main body of an essay is a series of paragraphs that explore and develop your argument.
ex.t: 文章的主体是一系列段落，用来探索和展开你的论点。

ex.s: End your essay by linking your conclusion back to the essay title.
ex.t: 通过将您的结论链接回论文标题来结束您的论文。

defs.def: a short piece of writing on a particular subject, written in order to be published （用来刊登的）论说文，小品文

ex.s: Examples in argumentative essays can serve several purposes.
ex.t: 论证性散文中的例子可以达到几个目的。

ex.s: The first book I picked up was Montaigne's Essays.
ex.t: 我拿起的第一本书是蒙田的《随笔集》。

ex.s: What did the author find when reading Montaigne’s Essays?
ex.t: 作者在读蒙田的《随笔集》时发现了什么？

defs.def: an attempt to do sth 企图；尝试

ex.s: 36   When you are first trying to think of ideas for an essay, put your pen to your paper and write nonstop for ten or fifteen minutes without letting your pen leave the paper.
ex.t: 36 当你最初试图为论文想点子时，把笔放在纸上，连续写十到十五分钟，不让笔离开纸。
